product_launches.description: Storyworth introduced its 2025 "Magical Winter Release," a suite of new features—Magic Questions, Magic Editor, Magic Layouts, and full Spanish language support—to improve personalization, editing, photo layout, and accessibility for its family memoir subscription service.

overview_description.description: StoryWorth is a service that makes it easy for families to record their stories. Each week they email their customers a question about their life, for example "What do you remember of your grandmother?". Their customers reply by email or by phone, and the stories are saved and shared privately with their family.
